decisions.reason: A two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's plural-component pumping and injection know-how, so it can interpret early results and refine the product.
This second resin injection unit sits in the firm's core plural-component competence, though as a parallel variant it carries a slightly higher risk of consolidation.
Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's spray application expertise and in-house engineering, so absorptive capacity is high.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory for the firm's pumps and draw on long experience, which makes continuation very likely.
This air-assisted airless gun line with several models extends the firm's established spray technology, so it can be refined using existing knowledge.

A data logger moves into electronics and digital monitoring, further from the firm's mechanical core, but it complements its coating equipment and engineering staff can still assimilate it, so it is kept with somewhat higher risk.
